create database if not exists \`cms_demo\` CHARACTER set utf8mb4;
use \`cms_demo\`;
create table if not exists \`cms_cate\`( id tinyint primary key comment '分类编号', cateName varchar(50) not null comment '分类名称', cateDesc varchar(200) comment '分类描述'
)comment '新闻分类表';

create table if not exists \`cms_news\`( id int primary key comment '新闻编号', title varchar(50) not null comment '新闻标题', content text comment '新闻内容', pubTime datetime not null DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP comment '发布时间', clickNum int not null DEFAULT 0 CHECK(clickNum>=0) comment '点击量', isTop tinyint UNSIGNED not null default 0 comment '是否置顶，0：不置顶，1：置顶', cId tinyint not null comment '所属分类', CONSTRAINT cId_cmsCate_fk foreign key(cId) REFERENCES cms_cate(id)
)comment '新闻表';
